indicator_name: 10-year yield differential: KZ government securities (KASE curve) minus US Treasuries
description: Дифференциал доходностей 10 лет: ГЦБ РК (кривая KASE) минус UST
methodology: Percentage points, monthly means: KASE zero-coupon government securities yield at 10 years (GS_YIELD_10Y) minus the 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (FRED GS10), from 2019-11. The KASE 10-year point is an extrapolation of thinly traded long bonds before 2024 (see GS_YIELD_10Y).
